sampling.method: Deterministic within-flow diversity sampling over claim status, region count, and region source, plus every non-missing claim with no returned region.

limitations: Author-conducted quality audit; not independent localization validation. Source outputs were generated before this form.

items.requirement_text: The system shall support stepwise progression through the checkout flow with consistent back and continue navigation controls.

A contribution work area that visibly requires authentication.
The distinction between those access conditions.
items.author_note: The supplemental box covers part of the cookie/privacy overlay rather than evidence distinguishing public contribution resources from authenticated work areas. Establishing the distinction requires broader cross-screen access evidence.

items.claim_text: Contribution-related actions are available from a top-level navigation menu.
author_missing_facts: One or more visible contribution actions inside the expanded Contribute menu.
items.author_note: The box correctly identifies the top-level Contribute label. It does not include any of the expanded contribution actions, such as Submission Guidelines or Submit a Release, that complete the claim.

items.requirement_text: The system shall surface route-specific café menu resources only when they are applicable to the traveler's route or service context, while still preserving access to a general national menu.

The generic Café-page context in which the route-specific links are surfaced.

items.author_note: The title correctly establishes that the reached page is the Onboard Dining detail page. List-to-detail navigation additionally requires the preceding overview screen and its navigation action.

Corresponding detail or menu resources for the remaining service types.

items.requirement_text: The system shall provide a dedicated pre-search review step or summary panel that lists all selected cruise criteria together and allows the user to edit any one of them before submitting the search.

The duration control.

The language and currency locale controls.

The Publisher field.
The ISBN field.

Order Status.
Wishlist.
The cart control.
Language and currency controls.

items.claim_text: The system supports searching for service categories such as hair salons within a selected city.

items.author_note: The selected entries are valid examples of city and neighborhood disambiguation, but two entries cannot establish complete coverage of all relevant matches in the much longer visible list.

items.requirement_text: The system shall surface only currently valid coupon offers that match the active business category and resolved locality.
items.claim_text: An active business category and resolved locality are available as search context.
items.author_note: The selected query and location controls directly show an active hair-salon category and the San Diego locality as the current search context.

items.requirement_text: The system shall send a confirmation to the purchaser's contact address after checkout that summarizes the selected park, pass tier, add-ons, and payment arrangement.
items.claim_text: A confirmation is sent to the contact address after checkout.
author_missing_facts: External evidence that a confirmation was actually delivered to the purchaser's contact address after checkout.
items.author_note: Sending or delivering a confirmation to an external contact address is not a visible screenshot region. A UI confirmation message could be localized, but it would still not prove external delivery.

items.requirement_text: The system shall display a synchronized purchase summary on the eGift card purchase page that visibly updates the currently selected amount and entered delivery details as the shopper configures the card.
items.claim_text: The eGift card purchase page displays a synchronized purchase summary.
author_missing_facts: The complete eGift-card configuration page showing whether a dedicated purchase summary is present or absent.
items.author_note: This contradicted claim concerns the absence of a synchronized summary. There is no positive summary element to localize; the appropriate evidence unit is the relevant whole-screen configuration state.

items.requirement_text: The system shall display a synchronized purchase summary on the eGift card purchase page that visibly updates the currently selected amount and entered delivery details as the shopper configures the card.
items.claim_text: The purchase summary updates the currently selected amount as the shopper configures the card.
author_missing_facts: Before-and-after configuration states showing an amount change and the corresponding purchase-summary state.
items.author_note: Updating a summary with the selected amount is a transition claim. Because no purchase summary is present to box, abstaining from region localization is appropriate; evaluation requires comparison across amount-selection states.

items.requirement_text: The system shall display a synchronized purchase summary on the eGift card purchase page that visibly updates the currently selected amount and entered delivery details as the shopper configures the card.
items.claim_text: The purchase summary updates the entered delivery details as the shopper configures the card.
author_missing_facts: Before-and-after configuration states showing changed delivery details and the corresponding purchase-summary state.
items.author_note: Updating a summary with delivery details is a transition claim. Because no purchase summary is present to box, abstaining from region localization is appropriate; evaluation requires comparison across delivery-detail states.

items.requirement_text: The system shall let users maintain reusable dining preferences that can inform future reservations.
items.claim_text: The preferences are reusable for future reservations after this flow.
author_missing_facts: Evidence from a later reservation showing that the previously stored preferences are available for reuse.
items.author_note: The current flow can show preference entry or saving, but it cannot visibly establish reuse in a future reservation after this flow. No present screenshot region can prove the future behavior.

items.requirement_text: The system shall keep the selected park context attached when an applicant proceeds from recruiting content into the application-start flow for a specific opening.
items.claim_text: The selected park context remains attached inside the application-start flow for the specific opening.
author_missing_facts: The visible White Water Atlanta park context and Lifeguard opening on the application-start page.
The preceding selected-park state required to establish preservation across the transition.
items.author_note: The target job page visibly contains both the specific Lifeguard opening and White Water Atlanta, so suitable target-screen candidates exist. The complete preservation claim additionally requires comparison with the preceding selected-park state; returning no region at all misses useful visible evidence.

items.requirement_text: The system shall provide an explicit transition from the release submission overview into the actual submission workflow so contributors can proceed directly from learning the rules to starting a release submission.
items.claim_text: The release submission overview provides an explicit transition into the actual submission workflow.
author_missing_facts: An explicit submission-start action or link on the release submission overview.
items.author_note: The contradicted claim concerns the absence of an explicit transition from the guidelines overview into the submission workflow. No corresponding transition control exists to localize; the relevant evidence is the overview screen as a whole.

items.requirement_text: The system shall provide an explicit transition from the release submission overview into the actual submission workflow so contributors can proceed directly from learning the rules to starting a release submission.
items.claim_text: Contributors can proceed directly from learning the rules to starting a release submission.
author_missing_facts: A direct action taking the contributor from the rules overview to release submission.
items.author_note: No direct release-submission transition is visible on the rules overview. Since the contradiction is based on an absent action and the failed transition, whole-screen or transition evidence is appropriate rather than a positive element box.
